The device did not accept this phone\u2019s ADB key, or it is not paired.
Re-pair the device, and tick \u201cAlways allow\u201d when it asks \u201cAllow debugging?\u201d.
The device could not be reached over the network.
Check that both devices are on the same Wi\u2011Fi, that the device is awake, and that its address has not changed.
The device answered, then the connection dropped.
Check the Wi\u2011Fi signal on both devices, then retry.
The device is reachable, but nothing is listening on this port.
Turn Wireless debugging off and on again; its port changes each time. Update the saved port, or re-pair.
The device refused the session or one of its settings.
Retry. If it repeats, use Connect from the device list, or reset this device\u2019s mirroring settings.
The device stopped answering in time.
Wake the device, check the Wi\u2011Fi signal, and retry. A busy or sleeping device can be slow to answer.
The video, audio or input stream could not be started on this phone or on the device.
Retry with a lower resolution or a different video codec in this device\u2019s settings.

Retry. If it repeats, copy the diagnostic details and check the technical message below.
